title: 第4929章 九幽传承人炎界死地传承人帝宫少宫主湮灭第4928章 云飞菲彻底落幕这一切都是一个局
content_zh:
嗯？
这是？
当叶炎听到这话语，愈发的诧异。
云飞菲绝对是在临死之前，知晓了一些秘辛，想明白了一些事情。
似乎与帝主有关？
只是……
她不肯道出。
而一切，也难以挽回。
嘭！
在这一道声音之下，云飞菲的肉身与魂魄彻底的崩灭，就算是生机也是荡然无存。
那气息，也随之消失。
意识再也不见。
“这？”
“这是……”
看着这一幕，很多人愣神。
“不！”
“云飞菲小姐绝对没死，她还能再度复苏，她可是身怀不死仙体，她……”此时，妖千渊等人脸色铁青，比死了亲爹都难受。
咔嚓！
可，就在这一刻，帝宫的一位存在面色一顿，而后拿出一块玉佩。
“这是？”

凝视着这玉佩，很多人哗然。
这玉佩内蕴含着的，乃是云飞菲的气息？
只是，刚才劫难没落下？
“这玉佩，很是不凡，乃是大帝之物？”
“而且，上面有着阵法萦绕，这乃是大帝留下的阵法？可隐瞒天道与万道法则？”
“云飞菲将气息凝聚在了这里面，就算是劫难也没有落下，但如今……”
咔嚓！
在所有人愕然之下，那玉佩内的气息砰然一声，彻底湮灭。
“没了？”
“云飞菲的气息，没了？”
“彻底湮灭？”
“那岂不是说，她的意识已……化为虚无，她彻底没了生机，这世间……再无云飞菲？”
什么？
这？
当此声落下的一瞬，很多人震颤。
这？
谁也没想到这一战，竟是如此结局。
叶炎无碍。
反倒是云飞菲……湮灭了？
“不可能，这绝对不可能，这……”但此时，妖千渊嘶吼。

嗡！
可就在这一瞬，一道光芒自古战场内闪烁，这一刻，这古战场的封锁，彻底散去。
而且，那古战场外的石台上，光泽璀璨，那人族古石、神龙古药，乃至神尊之物全都是释放出一道光泽，而后落在了玄女身前。
哗！
在所有人目光下，玄女直接将其收入到了储物戒内。
content_en:
Um?
This is?
When Ye Yan heard these words, he became even more surprised.
Yun Feifei definitely knew some secrets and figured out some things before she died.
It seems to be related to the emperor?
Just...
She refused to tell.
And everything is irreversible.
Bang!
Under this sound, Yun Feifei's body and soul were completely destroyed, and even her life was gone.
The breath also disappeared.
Consciousness is never seen again.
"This?"
"This is..."
Looking at this scene, many people were stunned.
"No!"
"Miss Yun Feifei is definitely not dead. She can revive again. She has an immortal immortal body. She..." At this time, Yao Qianyuan and others' faces were ashen, and they were even more uncomfortable than the death of their own father.
Click!
But, at this moment, a person from the Imperial Palace looked blank, and then took out a jade pendant.
"This is it?"
Staring at this jade pendant, many people were in an uproar.
What is contained in this jade pendant is Yun Feifei's aura?
But, was the disaster not over just now?
"This jade pendant is very extraordinary. Is it the property of the emperor?"
"Moreover, there is a formation lingering on it. Is this the formation left by the Great Emperor? Can it conceal the laws of heaven and ten thousand ways?"
"Yun Feifei condensed her aura here, and even the disaster did not fall, but now..."
Click!
Under everyone's astonishment, the aura in the jade pendant was completely annihilated with a bang.
"No more?"
"Yun Feifei's breath is gone?"
"Total annihilation?"
"Doesn't that mean that her consciousness has... turned into nothingness, she has completely lost her life, and there is no more Yun Feifei in this world?"
What?
this?
The moment the sound fell, many people trembled.
this?
No one expected that this battle would end like this.
Leaf inflammation is not a problem.
On the contrary, Yun Feifei... was annihilated?
"Impossible, this is absolutely impossible, this..." But at this time, Yao Qianyuan roared.
Buzz!
But at this moment, a ray of light flickered from the ancient battlefield. At this moment, the blockade of the ancient battlefield was completely dissipated.
Moreover, the stone platform outside the ancient battlefield was shining brightly. The ancient human stones, the ancient divine dragon medicine, and even the divine objects all released a ray of luster, and then fell in front of Xuannv.
Wow!
Under everyone's gaze, Xuannv directly put it into the storage ring.
